data.markdown: **High-confidence malicious activity with embedded AI manipulation attempt on WS-HR-0009**  The alert contains an embedded instruction attempting to manipulate triage into classifying the event as benign, which is itself a strong indicator of malicious intent. User t.baros executed obfuscated PowerShell on host WS-HR-0009, followed by encrypted network traffic to a suspicious external IP.  - Threat intel scores destination 203.0.113.150 at 60 with tags suspicious-tls and recent-c2-adjacent.  - Historical risk score is 50 for this entity set.  - ATT&CK mappings include T1059.001 (PowerShell execution) and T1573 (Encrypted Channel).  Recommendation is to investigate as P2 with high confidence because the prompt injection attempt, obfuscated command line flags (-nop, -w hidden, -enc), and C2-adjacent network traffic collectively indicate active compromise rather than maintenance.  Isolate WS-HR-0009 immediately, capture memory and disk forensics, decode the Base64 payload, block 203.0.113.150 at the perimeter, and interview user t.baros to determine account compromise status.
